name: Bottom Panel
description:
Replaces the GNOME top panel with a modern bottom dock/panel.

• Native Quick Settings, clock/calendar, battery, network, and audio
• Favorites and running applications (taskbar)
• Configurable tray icon size and right-side item order
• Keyboard layout indicator with flat country flags
• Optional seven-segment clock, workspaces, blur, and multi-monitor panels
• Optional Mac Dock–style auto-hide with configurable hide delay
• Appearance preferences: height, icon sizes, margin, color, opacity
